research_mode: official Police.uk sources only; date-versioned category and availability contracts, force identifiers and neighbourhood lookup semantics; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Date-versioned crime categories
verified_claims: the endpoint returns valid crime categories for a specified data-set date
the date parameter uses year-month semantics
category validity is tied to the requested edition
limitations: categories must not be assumed stable across all months
a category list is metadata rather than a crime count

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Crime-category identifier and label
verified_claims: each category includes a URL-form identifier
each category also includes a human-readable name
the identifier and display label are separate fields
limitations: display names must not be used as stable machine keys
category metadata does not establish local spatial precision

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Street-data availability months
verified_claims: the availability endpoint returns a list of available data sets
each entry includes a year-month date
the dates describe available street-level crime data editions
limitations: availability does not prove completeness for every field
an available month is not a parcel observation

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Monthly stop-search force coverage
verified_claims: each availability entry can list force identifiers that supplied stop-and-search data
coverage is month-specific
the force list is separate from the general crime-date field
limitations: absence from the list is not a zero count
coverage must be checked for the exact requested month

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Force-list BTP exclusion
verified_claims: the force-list endpoint returns police forces available through the API
British Transport Police is excluded from that particular list
BTP can nevertheless appear in other API data contexts
limitations: force-list absence does not mean BTP data never appears
force coverage must be interpreted per endpoint

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Unique force identifiers
verified_claims: the force endpoint supplies a unique force identifier
that identifier is used in force-specific API requests
the force name is supplied separately
limitations: force identifiers are not neighbourhood identifiers
identifier stability does not prove data completeness

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Specific-force metadata
verified_claims: the specific-force endpoint returns the force identifier
it returns a method or force website URL
force-level descriptive and contact metadata can be supplied
limitations: contact metadata is not crime evidence
website URLs and optional fields can change

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Force neighbourhood list
verified_claims: the endpoint lists neighbourhoods for a specified force
each item includes a team identifier
each item also includes a neighbourhood name
limitations: the list is force-scoped
neighbourhood entries are not parcel polygons

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Neighbourhood identifier scope
verified_claims: a neighbourhood identifier is specific to a police force
the same identifier may be used by another force
force and neighbourhood identifiers are both needed for an unambiguous key
limitations: neighbourhood ID alone is not globally unique
force-scoped teams are not official parcel identities

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Coordinate-to-neighbourhood lookup
verified_claims: the lookup accepts a latitude-longitude query
the response contains a force identifier
the response contains a force-specific neighbourhood identifier
limitations: the response is a policing-team lookup rather than a cadastral join
coordinate quality remains the caller's responsibility
